answer.reason: KilnStage maps one-for-one onto all seven KilnwisePhase values (SCHEDULED→Queued, CANDLING→Drying, …, FAULTED→Broken), and the mapping lives in the domain file itself. No domain spec or glossary names these stages, and PieceService mostly lumps the first four together, so the seven-way split comes from the vendor and the domain doesn't need it.
